title: Git Manager
subtitle: Register GitHub repos, push your changes up, and pull or back them up.
desktopOnly: The Git Manager is only available in the Omni desktop app.
unavailable: Git service is not running yet. The feature will be ready once the desktop bridge is connected.
selectRepo: Select a repository to manage it.

empty.title: No repositories yet
empty.hint: Register a GitHub repository by its URL and a token, then push, pull, and back it up from here.

register.title: Register a repository
register.remoteUrlHint: The HTTPS clone URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo.git
register.localPathHint: Where the repo lives (or will be cloned to) on this machine.
register.cloneNowHint: Download the repo into the folder right after registering.

detail.removeHint: This only unregisters it from Omni — your local files and the remote are untouched.
detail.notCloned: Not cloned yet — use Pull or Clone to download it.
detail.pullHint: Download the latest changes from GitHub (restore / update).
detail.cloneHint: Re-download the repository from GitHub into the local folder.
detail.syncHint: Pull brings updates down; Push backs your commits up. Commit first, then push.
detail.pushProtectedBody: You are about to push directly to "{{branch}}", a protected branch. Make sure this is intended.

op.commitFailed: Commit failed (nothing to commit, or an error).
op.pushFailed: Push failed — check your credential and network.
op.pullFailed: Pull failed — check your credential and network.

credentials.title: Git credentials
credentials.intro: Personal Access Tokens are encrypted on this device and used to authenticate push/pull. The full token is never shown again.
credentials.tokenHint: Create a token at github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens, with 'repo' scope.
